definition: Limited or restricted within clearly defined boundaries.
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
quote: Here, with you, everything is circumscribed, here all is formulated and geometrical, while we have nothing but indeterminate equations!
example_sentence: Life on the tiny island felt circumscribed.
